race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Auction Maiden
race.verdict: RAYASTAR was learning on the job and surely would have been placed but for blowing the start when fourth in a 6f maiden here on debut 3 weeks ago. Looking sure to be suited by this step up in trip, he can build on that effort and come out on top. Coloursofthewind also made a promising first start when third over C&D recently and along with Jezzie Bea and Celtic Comet heads the dangers. RAYASTAR (IRE) COLOURSOFTHEWIND (IRE) JEZZIE BEA (USA)
